screen1.heading: Welcome to Bimoto
screen1.body: Bimoto is the transport app that connects drivers, cyclists, passengers, and courier delivery.
screen1.illustrationAlt: A motorcycle and bicycle on a circle, representing rides across Rwanda

screen2.heading: Powered by cooperatives
screen2.body: You ride with drivers from your cooperative — and cooperative leaders are first-class users of the platform.
screen2.illustrationAlt: Three people connected in a triangle, representing the cooperative network

screen3.heading: Fixed-price bidding
screen3.body: Every price is a binding offer from the driver. No surge. No hidden fees. You choose.
screen3.illustrationAlt: A price tag with a checkmark and three bid offers, representing fixed-price bidding

ride.title: Request a ride
ride.body: Tap 'Request a ride' on the home screen, enter your pickup location and destination, and submit your request. A driver will then come to pick you up.

parcel.title: Send a parcel
parcel.body: Tap 'Send a parcel', enter the pickup and drop-off locations, and provide details about the item and the recipient. The driver collects the parcel and delivers it — you do not travel with it. For faster delivery, pick the Express option.

bidding.title: Offers and choosing a driver
bidding.body: After submitting your request, nearby drivers will respond with their fares. Compare their prices, ratings, and estimated arrival times, then accept your preferred offer. You can also suggest your own fare — use the fair-price hint to see what similar trips cost.

children.title: Travelling with children
children.body: Children under 12 are not an independent booking option on Bimoto — a child travels with a responsible adult, who makes the booking. When you book a ride you can tick 'Travelling with a child?' so the driver knows before they arrive.

sos.title: The SOS button
sos.body: During a ride, the red SOS button alerts the Bimoto team and your emergency contacts, and keeps the emergency number 112 one tap away. Use it whenever you feel unsafe — it never cancels your ride by itself. Motari and passenger each have the same button: whoever presses it, it alerts that person's own emergency contacts.

language.title: Change language
language.body: Open Profile and pick English, Français, or Kinyarwanda under Language. The choice is saved and applied every time you open the app.

help.title: Where to get help
help.body: During a trip, use the in-app chat to communicate with your driver. For anything else, contact the Bimoto support team at a pilot stand or through your local contact — they can review any trip with you.

trace.title: The route is recorded
trace.body: During your ride, the driver's phone records the route — for safety, and so that any dispute can be settled with facts rather than memory. It is deleted after 14 days unless a dispute is open, in which case it is kept until the dispute is settled. It is never visible live to anyone — except our safety team during an emergency, until the emergency is closed.

legal.privacyText: Bimoto collects your phone number, location (only when you share it), and ride history to match you with drivers and process payments. We encrypt your data and never share it with third parties except as needed to complete rides. You can delete your account and all data at any time.
legal.termsChildPolicy: Children: children under 12 are not an independent booking option. A child travels with a responsible adult, who makes the booking and stays with the child for the whole trip.
legal.driverTermsText: As a Bimoto driver, you agree to: offer only fixed prices, provide safe transport, follow traffic laws, wear and provide helmets, maintain valid RURA authorization and insurance, and allow GPS tracking during rides.
legal.diagnosticsConsent: When the app hits an error, this phone records what happened — the time, the app version, the screen you were on, and the error text. Phone numbers and sign-in codes are removed before it is saved. To help us fix problems quickly, these error records are sent automatically to the Bimoto team in Kigali. You can see exactly what would be sent on the Diagnostics screen, and you can turn automatic sending off at any time in Settings. Your messages, your trips and your location are never part of it.
legal.rideTraceNotice: Your position is recorded during rides and deliveries — for safety, and to settle disputes with facts. Traces are kept for 14 days and then deleted; if a ride is under dispute, its trace is kept until the dispute is settled. Nobody can watch your rides live — except our safety team during an emergency, until it is closed.
legal.safetyAckNoInfants: No babies or infants may ever be carried on a moto. This has no exception.
legal.safetyAckOnePassenger: A moto carries exactly one passenger. Never two, never a child in addition to an adult.
legal.safetyAckMinimumAge: Anyone below the legal minimum age for a moto passenger may not be carried.
legal.safetyAckDriverRefuse: As a driver, you also accept that you will refuse any ride that would break these rules, even if the passenger insists.
legal.safetyAckAgree: I have read and accept these three safety rules

deletion.exportNotice: This export contains the records Bimoto holds about you as a rider, a driver, and a party to your own rides. It deliberately leaves out our fraud-prevention and investigation records about this account — anti-money-laundering flags, administrator actions taken about you, name-mismatch checks, driver conflict overrides, and the tombstone kept after an account is deleted. Those are withheld so that a fraud check cannot be read by the person it is about. You can ask for them, and for the reasons behind them, by making a request to Bimoto support.

help.is18OrOlder: Bimoto is for drivers and cyclists aged 18 and over. We can't onboard you below that age. Applicants under 18 can still join the venture-team cohort in a different role.
help.holdsDriversLicence: We need a current Rwanda driver's licence valid for your vehicle category (A1 for motorcycle, A2 for general). 'In progress' means you've applied and have a receipt or test date booked.
help.hasRuraAuthorisation: RURA is Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Authority. Authorisation is required to transport passengers for hire. Don't worry if you don't have it yet — we can support your application.
help.primaryVehicleType: Pick the vehicle you'll use for 50% or more of your trips. You can update this later from your driver profile.
help.cooperativeAffiliation: Bimoto runs through transport cooperatives. If you're already in one, picking it speeds up onboarding because we have a relationship with your leader. If not, no problem — we'll match you.
help.primaryCityBand: Where will you usually pick up customers? Kigali Dense = central districts (Kacyiru, Nyamirambo, Kimironko). Kigali Periphery = suburbs and outskirts. Bugesera = the southern corridor toward Nyamata.
help.weeklyAvailabilityHours: Be realistic. Most active drivers commit 20+ hours per week. Lower availability is fine during soft launch and you can update this later.
help.priorPlatformExperience: Yego, SafeMotos, or any similar dispatch app. Helps us understand how comfortable you are with smartphone-based dispatch. Not required.
